name: HashiCorp Vault
description: A Github Action that allows you to consume HashiCorp Vault™ secrets as secure environment variables

url.description: The URL for the vault endpoint

secrets.description: A semicolon-separated list of secrets to retrieve. These will automatically be converted to environmental variable keys. See README for more details

pki.description: A semicolon-separated list of certificates to generate. These will automatically be converted to environment variable keys. Cannot be used with "secrets". See R

namespace.description: The Vault namespace from which to query secrets. Vault Enterprise only, unset by default

method.description: The method to use to authenticate with Vault.

role.description: Vault role for specified auth method

path.description: The Vault path for the auth method.

token.description: The Vault token to be used to authenticate with Vault

roleId.description: The role ID for App Role authentication

secretId.description: The secret ID for App Role authentication

githubToken.description: The Github Token to be used to authenticate with Vault

kubernetesTokenPath.description: The path to the Kubernetes service account secret

username.description: The username of the user to log in to Vault as. Available to both Userpass and LDAP auth methods

password.description: The password of the user to log in to Vault as. Available to both Userpass and LDAP auth methods

authPayload.description: The JSON payload to be sent to Vault when using a custom authentication method.

extraHeaders.description: A string of newline separated extra headers to include on every request.

exportEnv.description: Whether or not export secrets as environment variables.

exportToken.description: Whether or not export Vault token as environment variables.

outputToken.description: Whether or not to set the `vault_token` output to contain the Vault token after authentication.

caCertificate.description: Base64 encoded CA certificate the server certificate was signed with. Defaults to CAs provided by Mozilla.

clientCertificate.description: Base64 encoded client certificate for mTLS communication with the Vault server.

clientKey.description: Base64 encoded client key for mTLS communication with the Vault server.

tlsSkipVerify.description: When set to true, disables verification of the Vault server certificate.  Setting this to true in production is not recommended.

jwtPrivateKey.description: Base64 encoded Private key to sign JWT

jwtKeyPassword.description: Password for key stored in jwtPrivateKey (if needed)

jwtGithubAudience.description: Identifies the recipient ("aud" claim) that the JWT is intended for

jwtTtl.description: Time in seconds, after which token expires

secretEncodingType.description: The encoding type of the secret to decode. If not specified, the secret will not be decoded. Supported values: base64, hex, utf8

ignoreNotFound.description: Whether or not the action should exit successfully if some requested secrets were not found.
